claim: The _sql_call helper models the real agent's run_sql emission: a running card then a success/error card with the same metadata['sql'], with the DataFrame after the pair; the real agent's DataFrame position relative to the completed card does not change the hide decision, since the flag is set at the running card.
verify_against: the tool-call loop in src/sqllens/agent/core/agent/agent.py (order of the running card, the tool's ui_component and the completed card) and _sql_card in tests/unit/test_format.py
verify_hint: Check in agent.py whether the run_sql DataFrame UiComponent is yielded before or after the completed status card, and whether the completed card copies metadata['sql']
evidence: agent.py: running StatusCard built at 779-785 with metadata=tool_call.arguments and yielded (~812); completed card yielded at 953-956 via tool_status_card.set_status(...) on the same object, so metadata (sql) is preserved; result.ui_component (the DataFrame) yielded afterwards at 996-1026. So order is running card, success/error card, then DataFrame, matching _sql_call (test_format.py:1825-1828) and _sql_card (894-904, metadata={'sql': sql}, statuses running/success/error). In _format.py:425-431 the introspection flag last_sql_is_introspection is set when the SQL first changes (the running card), and the DATAFRAME branch at 386-389 reads it, so the hide decision is made at the running card and does not depend on the completed card's position relative to the DataFrame. Rejections lines do not cover this item.

claim: The comment asserts the control tests below it pass without a dialect and therefore hold on the code before #301.
source_excerpt: # Controls below pass without a dialect, so they hold on the code before #301.
verify_against: base-view components_to_blocks and is_introspection_query (view-base src/sqllens/tools/_format.py and src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py) and the three tests after line 1955
verify_hint: Trace test_data_only_turn_keeps_table_and_answer, test_dataframe_without_preceding_run_sql_card_is_shown and test_unparseable_sql_result_still_shown against the base components_to_blocks (no dialect kwarg, base DataFrame branch)
evidence: The three tests after the comment (tests/unit/test_format.py:1958-1976) call components_to_blocks(stream) with no dialect. Base components_to_blocks (view-base src/sqllens/tools/_format.py:251-551) takes only `components` and has no introspection filtering of DATAFRAMEs: every DATAFRAME with a payload becomes a table block, or a text block if it is exactly one row with at most 4 columns (lines 374-381). (1) data-only turn: a 2-row, 1-column df gives a table block, and the marked answer text gives a text block, so ['table','text']. (2) _catalog_df is 5 rows x 3 columns (test_format.py:1831-1836), so it is not a small result and gives ['table']; with no preceding run_sql card nothing else changes this. (3) unparseable SQL: the status cards only set last_sql, since base only calls is_introspection_query on a success card and that does not touch blocks. The 5-row catalog df gives ['table']. The tests use only helpers (_sql_call, _catalog_df, _answer_text) that build components and do not depend on the PR's new kwarg. So all three hold on the base code and the comment is accurate. The rejections lines concern other subjects and do not change this.

verify_against: build_agent in src/sqllens/agent/factory.py (line 89) and sqlglot_dialect_for_url in src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py
verify_hint: Compare factory.py's `dialect = sqlglot_dialect_for_url(cfg.database.url)` with query_database.py's components_to_blocks call, and check that the removed factory._sqlglot_dialect body equals sqlglot_dialect_for_url
evidence: query_database.py:290-292 calls components_to_blocks(components, dialect=sqlglot_dialect_for_url(cfg.database.url)); factory.py:89 uses dialect = sqlglot_dialect_for_url(cfg.database.url) for ReadOnlyGuardRunner, the same imported function from sqllens.safety. readonly.py:67-76 body (scheme prefix sqlite/postgres/mysql else None) is identical to the removed factory._sqlglot_dialect body shown in diff.patch. claim: `make_tool_cards('run_sql', {'sql': ...})` produces STATUS_CARDs whose `metadata['sql']` carries the SQL (as the real agent's run_sql cards do), and `make_dataframe` produces a DATAFRAME component the formatter renders as a table block.
verify_against: `make_tool_cards` and `make_dataframe` in tests/unit/_agent_stubs.py and the agent's status-card emission in src/sqllens/agent/core/agent/agent.py
verify_hint: Read `make_tool_cards` (tests/unit/_agent_stubs.py line 96) for the metadata it sets and its running/completed statuses, and `make_dataframe` (line 174)
evidence: tests/unit/_agent_stubs.py:96-146 make_tool_cards builds running+success StatusCardComponents with metadata=args, so metadata['sql'] carries the SQL. The real agent does the same: agent.py:779-785 sets metadata=tool_call.arguments on the 'Executing {tool}' running card. _format.py:419-423 reads metadata.get('sql') from the card. make_dataframe (stubs:174-186) wraps a DataFrameComponent (ComponentType.DATAFRAME). _format.py:386-394 turns a DATAFRAME into a 'table' block unless it is a one-row small result (_small_result_to_markdown, 1297-1314, needs exactly 1 row). The test's 2-row and 3-row frames therefore render as table blocks, and the test asserts blocks types ['table','text']. The claim holds for the multi-row frames the test uses. A one-row frame would render as result_text, not a table.
